_doc: The living town (GDD 4.11, 4.5.4, 4.20; docs/contratos/h7_ciudad.md). Catalog.town. Durations in game minutes or days (1 year = 8 days, D1(b)); chances in [0, 1]. Marked [balance] in the GDD: adjusted with bots.
_routine_doc: 4.11.2. Townsfolk = living adults with a house, no job, of a household family (AI without profile). Dawn: leave home at the phase start + a delay drawn per person and day (leave_home_delay_minutes) and walk to the trade (occupation). Day: at the trade; every hour on the hour a chance (drawn per person and day in break_chance_per_hour) of a social break of break_minutes; at market_hour, market_visit_chance of strolling the market instead. Dusk: free time, chaining activities. Night: everybody home (whatever they were doing). retry_minutes: after a refused order. chat_wait_minutes: alone at a chat point this long, it gives up. greet: two walking townsfolk 1 tile apart stop with greet.chance (checked every check_every minutes, at most per_day each; each pair tries once a day) [balance: with every crossing greeting, the start of dusk was all greetings]. child_stays_home: under majority_age they never go out [provisional].
_activities_doc: 4.11.3 (cosmetic in the MVP). minutes = [min, max] of game time; market: per_stall_minutes at each of `stalls` [min, max] stall service tiles. spot: where it happens (social_points of that kind on the map, the market stalls, the doors of the non-house buildings, or none = where it is). bubble: the bubble id over the head (game/visuals/bubbles/<id>.tscn). weight: base weight when choosing; favored_by: the stat that makes it 3x likelier at >= personality.stat_min. greet is not chosen: it happens when two cross.
_emotions_doc: 4.11.5, the 4 of the MVP. duration_days [min, max] drawn when it starts [balance]; intensity starts at 100 and falls linearly to 0 at the end. buy_mult / sell_mult: what the actor's family pays buying from / gets selling to this NPC (stall keeper, shop clerk, counter customer). employee_mult: multiplies an employee's efficiency while it holds it towards its employer family. refuses_talk: npc_talk and court_talk refused. refuses_trade_over: above this intensity it will not trade (null = never). relation_on_expire: residual change of the permanent relation when it ends (GDD: ofensa no disculpada -3). icon: the emotion bubble id. incompatible: pairs where the newest replaces the other. max_per_source: active states of an NPC towards the same family.
_actions_doc: 4.11.5, the player's actions on an NPC (its panel). range_tiles: like courtship (to the NPC on the map or to the door of the building it is in; inside the same building also). talk: +relation once per day and pair (refused by refuses_talk emotions). gift: one unit of an item; value = market sell price; > grateful_min_value -> grateful, else +value / gold_per_point relation up to max_relation. flatter: SkillCheck charisma vs empathy, once per day; success / fail relation (Halagado is POST-MVP) [provisional]. insult: offended and relation. threaten: SkillCheck martial vs martial; success scared and relation (GDD: relacion -5); fail angry [provisional].
_skill_check_doc: 4.2.4: threshold = base + (actor stat - target stat) x step + modifiers; roll d100; <= critical_success is a critical success, >= critical_fail a critical failure, else success if roll <= threshold.
_counter_doc: 4.5.4. A building with counter_sales (forge_commerce_1) gets a customer every interval_hours [min, max] / (1 + customer_bonus) during `phases`: a free townsperson walks in and waits at the counter. Served by whoever holds the counter station (family) or an active employee with role counter inside, after serve_minutes; nobody in patience_minutes -> it leaves. Price = base_price x quality_mult x (1 + charisma/100 + rank_bonus + (price_multiplier - 1) + min(reputation/100 x reputation_mult, reputation_cap)) x the customer's sell_mult. Ledger category counter_sales (a source, 4.19).
_microevents_doc: 4.20. At dawn, each playing family (human or AI with a profile) that owns buildings rolls base_chance x the difficulty's microevent_chance; at most max_per_family_day. The microevents themselves: data/microevents/<id>.json. timeout_hours: the default of a microevent without its own. thief_start_hours: the thief comes this many hours [min, max] after night starts.
_population_doc: Renewal of the town (H8 gap, docs/contratos/h7_ciudad.md) [provisional, the GDD only says 15-20 NPC]. At dawn single townsfolk marry (a man and a woman of different houses, both >= marriage_min_age, she <= mother_max_age - 5) with marriage_chance while more than min_singles singles are left; children come through Births (data/family.json children) only while the town has fewer than max_total townsfolk (children included). At year_changed, with fewer than min_adults adults, newcomers arrive (newcomer_age, rank newcomer_rank) to the house with fewest people (house_capacity at most).
